name: dash-for-cloudflare
description: Dash for Cloudflare — a native SwiftUI client with a stateless OAuth relay
author: Xat <i@xat.sh>(https://xat.sh)

scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Dash.xcodeproj -scheme Dash -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.ios:test: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Dash.xcodeproj -scheme Dash -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -allowProvisioningUpdates -parallel-testing-enabled NO test
scripts.typecheck: turbo typecheck && pnpm api:test && pnpm ios:build
scripts.lint:swift: xcrun swift format lint --strict --recursive apps/ios/Dash apps/ios/DashWidgets apps/ios/DashTests apps/ios/DashUITests packages/cloudflare-api
scripts.lint:fix:swift: xcrun swift format --in-place --recursive apps/ios/Dash apps/ios/DashWidgets apps/ios/DashTests apps/ios/DashUITests packages/cloudflare-api
